body:
## Parent

Part of #3

## What to build

The local-first document store of ADR-0002, as package code with no app files. Each session is a folder with media and one versioned session document written atomically as canonical JSON. SessionStore is a single-writer actor: create, load, append([Event]) as one atomic write for a batch, update(facet:), updateRecording(_:) for capture metadata, list with search over players, courts and notes and filters for type, state and sample, trash, restore from trash, purge (requires a confirmation token), rebuild the index, migrate older documents forward and quarantine an unreadable document with a reason. The four facets (original, analysis, review, archive) are independent enums. Head-to-head and opponent history are queries. MediaLibrary in JovraMedia takes custody of session media, reports per-session sizes and derived-cache sizes, and exposes the include-originals-in-device-backup API; originals are excluded from iCloud device backup by default (D7). The UI row for that setting belongs to T51. After this ticket no later ticket edits the store; a missing API goes into a small store-fix PR. Why blocked: T03 (stores the Swift session models as canonical JSON).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A simulated crash between the temp write and the rename leaves the previous document loadable and the temp file ignored.
- [ ] Two concurrent writers (an event append and a facet update) both land, with no lost write (test runs 1,000 interleavings).
- [ ] append of 5 events is one atomic write: a crash injected mid-batch leaves either none or all 5 in the document.
- [ ] Deleting the index then listing rebuilds summaries identical to those before deletion.
- [ ] A corrupt session document is quarantined with its reason while every other session still lists.
- [ ] A version-1.0.0 document fixture migrates to the current schema version and validates.
- [ ] Trash then restore round-trips; purge without a confirmation token is refused; Trash never auto-empties originals unless the retention flag is set.
- [ ] Originals written through MediaLibrary carry the backup-exclusion flag by default and session documents do not; the API call to include originals flips every original (unit test).
- [ ] The package has no dependency on the app target (the ticket adds no file under the app folder).

## Evidence required

- [ ] swift test output for JovraCore and JovraMedia with test counts, including the concurrency test
- [ ] Green jovra-core Linux CI link

## Screens

None (no reference screen).

## Backlog items / user stories

- **131.** As a player, I want Trash never to auto-empty originals unless I turn that on in the retention editor, so that nothing irreplaceable disappears silently.
- **134.** As a player, I want the library rebuilt automatically from session folders if its index is ever lost, so that a corrupt index never hides my sessions.
- **386.** As a player, I want a session document that fails to load to be quarantined and reported without crashing the app or hiding other sessions, so that one bad file does not break my library.
- **388.** As a player upgrading the app, I want older session documents migrated forward automatically, so that updates never strand my data.

## Owned areas

- `ios/Packages/JovraCore/Sources/JovraCore/SessionStore`
- `ios/Packages/JovraMedia/Sources/JovraMedia/Library`

## Blocked by

- #5 (T03)
